title: Matthew Brown: White House AI timeline management system
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Matthew Brown: White House AI timeline management system, about present at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Matthew Brown also talked about some AI timeline management system that the White House has or whatever.
the White House possesses a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events.
tellings.difference: Says the AI accurately predicts a range of future events, where the story calls it a timeline management system.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Matthew Brown's claim that the White House has an AI system for predicting or managing timelines.

as_told.title: White House AI that predicts future events

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Matthew Brown, a former government official turned whistleblower, has talked about a computer system run by artificial intelligence that the White House supposedly has for managing timelines. In a later episode, Michels describes it as a special AI that can accurately predict a range of future events. If true, it would mean the US government can see some of the future before it happens.
